# env

## Interfaces

| Interface                                          | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [DrizzleEnvSchema](interfaces/DrizzleEnvSchema.md) | Environment variables for the `@saflib/drizzle` package, including inherited variables via `extends`. Generated by `@saflib/env`. To update, make changes to the adjacent `env.schema.json`, navigate to the package root, and run `npm exec saf-env generate`. |
